author: Daniel Greene
description:
Project Hail Mary is a modern sci-fi classic. Andy Weir's novel about a lone astronaut, a dying sun, and one very unlikely friendship has now been adapted into a film starring Ryan Gosling. So what changed between page and screen? Here are the biggest differences between the book and the movie, and whether they work.
